modstats.lead: Type a stat (e.g. Strength, Efficiency) to list the mods that change it, with their effects from rank 0 to max. Press Enter without picking a suggestion to search the effect text instead.
modstats.pick: Pick a stat from the suggestions, or press Enter to search the effect text.
modstats.empty: Type a stat (e.g. Strength, Efficiency) or part of an effect text.
modstats.nodata: No mod effect data yet. Fetch it from "Data Update".
modstats.more: Showing the first {n}. Add words or narrow down by category.
